dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Strongly falcate trailing edge characterized by a deep concavity between the apex and a secondary posterior projection.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Acute shape classification with a narrow, pointed pixel radius at the highest morphological point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Gradual convex slope with a low initial angle relative to the horizontal body axis, steepening toward the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: High width-to-height ratio with an elongated base relative to the vertical fin height.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive distribution of small, white circular depigmented spots across the lateral surface; a prominent, deep V-shaped notch on the lower trailing edge.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique bi-pointed appearance of the posterior margin due to significant structural loss below the primary apex.
